title.zh: 第 1 章 数系
title.en: Chapter 1 Number Systems

title.zh: 整数
title.en: Integers

points.zh: 自然数由 $1,2,3,\dots$ 计数得到，本课程不把 $0$ 计入自然数，自然数集记作 $\mathbb{N}$。
points.en: Natural numbers come from counting $1,2,3,\dots$; in this course $0$ is not counted as a natural number, and the set of natural numbers is denoted by $\mathbb{N}$.

points.zh: 整数上的加法满足交换律 $a+b=b+a$ 与结合律 $(a+b)+c=a+(b+c)$。
points.en: Addition on the integers satisfies commutativity $a+b=b+a$ and associativity $(a+b)+c=a+(b+c)$.

points.zh: 减法只在 $a>b$ 时对自然数有定义，且不满足交换律与结合律。
points.en: Subtraction of natural numbers is only defined when $a>b$, and it satisfies neither commutativity nor associativity.

points.zh: 引入 $0$ 与负整数后，$a+0=0+a=a$ 且 $a+(-a)=0$，其中 $0$ 是加法单位元、$-a$ 是 $a$ 的加法逆元，于是减法可写成 $a-b=a+(-b)$。
points.en: Once $0$ and negative integers are introduced, $a+0=0+a=a$ and $a+(-a)=0$, where $0$ is the additive unit and $-a$ is the additive inverse of $a$; subtraction then becomes $a-b=a+(-b)$.

points.zh: 整数乘法满足交换律 $a\times b=b\times a$、结合律 $(a\times b)\times c=a\times(b\times c)$ 以及对加法的分配律 $a\times(b+c)=a\times b+a\times c$。
points.en: Integer multiplication satisfies commutativity $a\times b=b\times a$, associativity $(a\times b)\times c=a\times(b\times c)$ and distributivity over addition $a\times(b+c)=a\times b+a\times c$.

points.zh: 带余除法：若 $a,b$ 为正整数且 $b\ge 2$，则存在唯一的整数 $q$ 与 $r$ 使 $a=bq+r$，$0\le r\le b-1$，$q$ 为商、$r$ 为余数。
points.en: Division with remainder: if $a,b$ are positive integers with $b\ge 2$, there are unique integers $q,r$ with $a=bq+r$ and $0\le r\le b-1$, where $q$ is the quotient and $r$ is the remainder.

points.zh: 进制表示：$\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}_b=a_n\times b^n+a_{n-1}\times b^{n-1}+\dots+a_1\times b+a_0$，十进制即 $b=10$ 的情形。
points.en: Base representation: $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}_b=a_n\times b^n+a_{n-1}\times b^{n-1}+\dots+a_1\times b+a_0$; the decimal system is the case $b=10$.

title.zh: 有理数、无理数与实数
title.en: Rational Numbers, Irrational Numbers, Real Numbers

points.zh: 分数形如 $\dfrac{p}{q}$，其中 $p,q$ 为整数且 $q\neq 0$；若 $p,q$ 除 $1,-1$ 外没有公因子，则称该分数为最简分数。
points.en: A fraction has the form $\dfrac{p}{q}$ with $p,q$ integers and $q\neq 0$; if $p$ and $q$ have no common factor other than $1$ and $-1$, the fraction is said to be in lowest terms.

points.zh: 分数也称有理数，有理数集记作 $\mathbb{Q}$，其上加法与乘法可以按分数运算来定义。
points.en: Fractions are also called rational numbers; the set of rational numbers is denoted by $\mathbb{Q}$, and addition and multiplication extend to them through the usual fraction rules.

points.zh: 有理数可以在数轴上表示：若 $r_1+(-r_2)$ 为正数，则 $r_1$ 在 $r_2$ 的右边。
points.en: Rational numbers can be represented on the number line: $r_1$ lies to the right of $r_2$ if $r_1+(-r_2)$ is positive.

points.zh: 单位正方形的对角线长为 $\sqrt{2}$，它不是有理数，说明有理数之外还有别的数。
points.en: The diagonal of a unit square has length $\sqrt{2}$, which is not rational, so numbers beyond the rational ones exist.

points.zh: 幂的定义：$x^n=\underbrace{x\times\dots\times x}_{n\text{ terms}}$，$x^{-n}=\dfrac{1}{x^n}$，并约定 $x^0=1$；指数律为 $x^m\times x^n=x^{m+n}$ 与 $\dfrac{x^m}{x^n}=x^{m-n}$。
points.en: Powers are defined by $x^n=\underbrace{x\times\dots\times x}_{n\text{ terms}}$, $x^{-n}=\dfrac{1}{x^n}$, with $x^0=1$; the exponent laws are $x^m\times x^n=x^{m+n}$ and $\dfrac{x^m}{x^n}=x^{m-n}$.

points.zh: 有限小数 $\overline{a_n\dots a_0.a_{-1}\dots a_{-m}}$ 表示 $a_n\times10^n+\dots+a_0+\dfrac{a_{-1}}{10}+\dots+\dfrac{a_{-m}}{10^m}$；无限循环小数按同样方式展开为无穷级数。
points.en: A finite decimal $\overline{a_n\dots a_0.a_{-1}\dots a_{-m}}$ represents $a_n\times10^n+\dots+a_0+\dfrac{a_{-1}}{10}+\dots+\dfrac{a_{-m}}{10^m}$; an infinite decimal expansion is written in the same way as an infinite series.

points.zh: 几何级数 $1+r+r^2+r^3+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$（$0<r<1$），它是把循环小数化为分数的关键工具。
points.en: The geometric series $1+r+r^2+r^3+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$ for $0<r<1$ is the key tool for turning a repeating decimal into a fraction.

title.zh: 代数数与超越数
title.en: Algebraic Numbers and Transcendental Numbers

points.zh: 定义 1.1：若数 $x$ 满足整系数多项式方程 $a_nx^n+a_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+a_1x+a_0=0$（$a_n\neq 0$），则称 $x$ 为代数数。
points.en: Definition 1.1: a number $x$ is called algebraic if it satisfies a polynomial equation $a_nx^n+a_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+a_1x+a_0=0$ with $a_n\neq 0$ and all coefficients $a_0,a_1,\dots,a_n$ integers.

points.zh: 不是代数数的数称为超越数；例如 $\sqrt{2}$ 满足 $x^2-2=0$，故为代数数。
points.en: A number that is not algebraic is called transcendental; for instance $\sqrt{2}$ satisfies $x^2-2=0$, so it is algebraic.

points.zh: 定理 1.3：每个有理数都是代数数。
points.en: Theorem 1.3: every rational number is an algebraic number.

points.zh: 定理 1.4：若 $a,b$ 都是代数数，则 $a+b$、$a-b$ 与 $ab$ 也都是代数数。
points.en: Theorem 1.4: if $a$ and $b$ are algebraic numbers, then so are $a+b$, $a-b$ and $ab$.

points.zh: 讲义例 1.9 指出 $\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$ 也是代数数（与习题 1.11 的 $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt[3]{2}$ 同类）。
points.en: Lecture Example 1.9 shows that $\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$ is algebraic (the same style of argument as exercise 1.11 with $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt[3]{2}$).

points.zh: $\pi$ 是超越数，由 Ferdinand von Lindemann 于 1882 年证明。
points.en: $\pi$ is transcendental, proved by Ferdinand von Lindemann in 1882.

points.zh: Joseph Liouville 于 1844 年首次证明超越数存在；Georg Cantor 于 1874 年证明超越数远多于代数数。
points.en: Joseph Liouville first proved the existence of transcendental numbers in 1844; in 1874 Georg Cantor proved that there are far more transcendental numbers than algebraic ones.

title.zh: 自然数、整数集与加法单位元
title.en: Natural Numbers, the Integers and the Additive Unit

body.zh: 数数得到 $1,2,3,\dots$，这些数叫自然数，本课程不把 $0$ 计入其中，自然数集记作 $\mathbb{N}$，它们有无穷多个，也叫正整数。整数集 $\mathbb{Z}$ 由正整数、$0$ 与负整数组成。为了让 $3-3$ 与 $3-5$ 有意义，引入 $0$ 和负数 $-a$。此时加法除交换律、结合律外还满足 $a+0=0+a=a$ 与 $a+(-a)=0$，于是 $0$ 叫加法单位元、$-a$ 叫 $a$ 的加法逆元，减法统一写成 $a-b=a+(-b)$。
body.en: Counting gives $1,2,3,\dots$, the natural numbers; this course does not include $0$ among them, and the set is denoted by $\mathbb{N}$; there are infinitely many of them, and they are also called positive integers. The set of integers $\mathbb{Z}$ contains the positive integers, $0$ and the negative integers. To make $3-3$ and $3-5$ meaningful we introduce $0$ and the negative $-a$. Besides commutativity and associativity, addition then satisfies $a+0=0+a=a$ and $a+(-a)=0$, so $0$ is the additive unit and $-a$ is the additive inverse of $a$, and subtraction is written $a-b=a+(-b)$.

title.zh: 乘法运算律与符号法则
title.en: Laws of Multiplication and Sign Rules

body.zh: 正整数的乘法定义为重复加法，例如 $5\times3=3+3+3+3+3=15$。乘法满足交换律 $a\times b=b\times a$、结合律 $(a\times b)\times c=a\times(b\times c)$，并对加法满足分配律 $a\times(b+c)=a\times b+a\times c$。这些性质可延拓到所有整数。特别地 $0\times a=a\times0=0$，$1\times a=a\times1=a$，符号法则为：正数乘正数为正，正数乘负数为负，负数乘负数为正。
body.en: Multiplication of positive integers is defined as repeated addition, e.g. $5\times3=3+3+3+3+3=15$. It satisfies commutativity $a\times b=b\times a$, associativity $(a\times b)\times c=a\times(b\times c)$ and distributivity over addition $a\times(b+c)=a\times b+a\times c$. These properties extend to all integers. In particular $0\times a=a\times0=0$ and $1\times a=a\times1=a$, and the sign rules are: positive times positive is positive, positive times negative is negative, negative times negative is positive.

title.zh: 带余除法与进制表示
title.en: Division with Remainder and Base Representation

body.zh: 若 $a,b$ 是正整数且 $b\ge 2$，则存在唯一的整数 $q,r$ 使 $a=bq+r$，$0\le r\le b-1$；$q$ 是商，$r$ 是余数。当 $r=0$ 时称 $b$ 整除 $a$、$b$ 是 $a$ 的因子、$a$ 是 $b$ 的倍数。日常使用十进制，$\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}=a_n\times10^n+\dots+a_1\times10+a_0$；一般地 $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}_b=a_n\times b^n+\dots+a_1\times b+a_0$。进制换算的基本手法是：十进制转 $b$ 进制反复除以 $b$ 取余并倒序读出；$b$ 进制转二进制按每位展开（$8=2^3$），二进制转 $b$ 进制按每 $\log_2 b$ 位一组。
body.en: If $a,b$ are positive integers with $b\ge 2$, there are unique integers $q,r$ with $a=bq+r$ and $0\le r\le b-1$; $q$ is the quotient and $r$ the remainder. When $r=0$ we say that $b$ divides $a$, that $b$ is a factor of $a$ and that $a$ is a multiple of $b$. In daily use we write base 10, $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}=a_n\times10^n+\dots+a_1\times10+a_0$; in general $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_1 a_0}_b=a_n\times b^n+\dots+a_1\times b+a_0$. The conversion tricks are: decimal to base $b$ by repeated division by $b$ reading the remainders in reverse; base $b$ to binary by expanding each digit since $8=2^3$; binary to base $b$ by grouping bits in blocks of $\log_2 b$.

title.zh: 分数与有理数
title.en: Fractions and Rational Numbers

body.zh: 分数是形如 $\dfrac{p}{q}$（$p,q$ 为整数，$q\neq0$）的数；若 $p,q$ 除了 $1,-1$ 外没有公因子，则称 $\dfrac{p}{q}$ 为最简分数。分数也称有理数，其全体记作 $\mathbb{Q}$，加法与乘法按 $\dfrac{p}{q}\pm\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps\pm rq}{qs}$、$\dfrac{p}{q}\times\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{pr}{qs}$、$\dfrac{p}{q}\div\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps}{qr}$ 运算。$\mathbb{Q}$ 对这四种运算封闭（$b\neq0$ 时）。
body.en: A fraction is a number of the form $\dfrac{p}{q}$ where $p,q$ are integers and $q\neq0$; if $p$ and $q$ share no factor other than $1$ and $-1$ the fraction is in lowest terms. Fractions are also called rational numbers and the set is denoted by $\mathbb{Q}$, with operations $\dfrac{p}{q}\pm\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps\pm rq}{qs}$, $\dfrac{p}{q}\times\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{pr}{qs}$ and $\dfrac{p}{q}\div\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps}{qr}$. The set $\mathbb{Q}$ is closed under these four operations (when $b\neq0$).

title.zh: 数轴、无理数与 $\sqrt{2}$
title.en: The Number Line, Irrational Numbers and $\sqrt{2}$

body.zh: 有理数可以摆在数轴上：两个有理数 $r_1,r_2$ 中，若 $r_1+(-r_2)$ 是正数，则 $r_1$ 位于 $r_2$ 的右侧。并非所有数都是有理数——单位正方形的对角线长为 $\sqrt{2}$，讲义例 1.5 证明 $\sqrt{2}$ 不是有理数（用反证法：设 $\sqrt{2}=\dfrac{p}{q}$，则 $p^2=2q^2$，由奇偶性矛盾）。无理数比有理数多得多，但证明一个数无理相当困难；$\pi$ 的无理性直到 18 世纪才被证明。
body.en: Rational numbers sit on the number line: for two rational numbers $r_1,r_2$, $r_1$ is to the right of $r_2$ if $r_1+(-r_2)$ is positive. Not every number is rational — the diagonal of a unit square has length $\sqrt{2}$, and lecture Example 1.5 proves $\sqrt{2}$ is not rational by contradiction: assume $\sqrt{2}=\dfrac{p}{q}$, then $p^2=2q^2$, and the parity of $p$ and $q$ gives a contradiction. There are far more irrational numbers than rational ones, but proving irrationality is hard; the irrationality of $\pi$ was only proved in the 18th century.

title.zh: 幂与指数运算律
title.en: Powers and the Laws of Exponents

body.zh: 若 $x$ 是一个数、$n$ 为正整数，定义 $x^n=\underbrace{x\times\dots\times x}_{n\text{ terms}}$，$x^{-n}=\dfrac{1}{x^n}$，并定义 $x^0=1$。对任意整数 $m,n$ 有 $x^m\times x^n=x^{m+n}$ 与 $\dfrac{x^m}{x^n}=x^{m-n}$。这三条是化简指数式与处理循环小数的工具。
body.en: If $x$ is a number and $n$ a positive integer, define $x^n=\underbrace{x\times\dots\times x}_{n\text{ terms}}$, $x^{-n}=\dfrac{1}{x^n}$, and define $x^0=1$. For any integers $m,n$ we have $x^m\times x^n=x^{m+n}$ and $\dfrac{x^m}{x^n}=x^{m-n}$. These three rules are the working tools for simplifying exponential expressions and for handling repeating decimals.

title.zh: 有限小数与循环小数
title.en: Finite and Repeating Decimals

body.zh: 正有限小数写成 $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\cdots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}\cdots a_{-m}}$，它表示 $a_n\times10^n+a_{n-1}\times10^{n-1}+\dots+a_0+\dfrac{a_{-1}}{10}+\dfrac{a_{-2}}{10^2}+\dots+\dfrac{a_{-m}}{10^m}$。无限小数 $\overline{a_na_{n-1}\dots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}a_{-3}\dots}$ 表示同样的无穷展开。当 $0<r<1$ 时 $1+r+r^2+r^3+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$，于是循环小数可写成等比级数并求和，例如 $0.0\overline{14}=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}$。
body.en: A positive finite decimal is written $\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\cdots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}\cdots a_{-m}}$ and represents $a_n\times10^n+a_{n-1}\times10^{n-1}+\dots+a_0+\dfrac{a_{-1}}{10}+\dfrac{a_{-2}}{10^2}+\dots+\dfrac{a_{-m}}{10^m}$. An infinite decimal $\overline{a_na_{n-1}\dots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}a_{-3}\dots}$ stands for the corresponding infinite expansion. For $0<r<1$ we have $1+r+r^2+r^3+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$, so a repeating decimal becomes a geometric series that can be summed, for instance $0.0\overline{14}=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}$.

title.zh: 定理 1.1 与定理 1.2
title.en: Theorems 1.1 and 1.2

body.zh: 定理 1.1：所有有理数都可以写成有限小数或循环小数。定理 1.2：有限小数或循环小数表示一个有理数。两者合起来说明有理数与有限/循环小数是同一集合的两个侧面。所有小数的全体称为实数集，记作 $\mathbb{R}$。
body.en: Theorem 1.1: all rational numbers can be written as finite decimals or repeating decimals. Theorem 1.2: a finite or repeating decimal represents a rational number. Together they say that rational numbers and finite/repeating decimals are two views of the same set. The set of all decimals is called the set of real numbers, denoted by $\mathbb{R}$.

title.zh: 定义 1.1：代数数与超越数
title.en: Definition 1.1: Algebraic and Transcendental Numbers

body.zh: 若数 $x$ 满足多项式方程 $a_nx^n+a_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+a_1x+a_0=0$（$a_n\neq0$），其中所有系数 $a_0,a_1,\dots,a_n$ 都是整数，则称 $x$ 为代数数（Definition 1.1）；不是代数数的数称为超越数。例 1.8 给出 $\sqrt{2}$ 满足 $x^2-2=0$，故 $\sqrt{2}$ 是代数数。要证明一个数是代数数，只需找出一个系数全为整数的多项式方程使它成立。
body.en: If a number $x$ satisfies the polynomial equation $a_nx^n+a_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+a_1x+a_0=0$ with $a_n\neq0$ and all coefficients $a_0,a_1,\dots,a_n$ integers, then $x$ is called an algebraic number (Definition 1.1); a number that is not algebraic is called transcendental. Example 1.8 gives that $\sqrt{2}$ satisfies $x^2-2=0$, so $\sqrt{2}$ is algebraic. To prove a number algebraic you only need to exhibit one polynomial equation with integer coefficients that it satisfies.

title.zh: 定理 1.3 与定理 1.4：代数数的封闭性
title.en: Theorems 1.3 and 1.4: Closure Properties of Algebraic Numbers

body.zh: 定理 1.3：每个有理数都是代数数（因为 $\dfrac{p}{q}$ 满足 $qx-p=0$）。定理 1.4：若 $a,b$ 都是代数数，则 $a+b$、$a-b$、$ab$ 也都是代数数。这两条定理解释了为什么 $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{3}$、$\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$ 之类看起来复杂的数仍是代数数：它们由已知代数数经四则运算得到。习题 1.13 与 1.14 是定理 1.4 的具体推广：代数数乘有理数仍是代数数；代数数的平方根仍是代数数。
body.en: Theorem 1.3: every rational number is an algebraic number (since $\dfrac{p}{q}$ satisfies $qx-p=0$). Theorem 1.4: if $a$ and $b$ are algebraic numbers, then so are $a+b$, $a-b$ and $ab$. These two theorems explain why expressions such as $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{3}$ or $\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$ are still algebraic: they are obtained from known algebraic numbers by arithmetic. Exercises 1.13 and 1.14 extend Theorem 1.4: an algebraic number times a rational number is algebraic, and the square root of an algebraic number is algebraic.

title.zh: 超越数的三个历史事实
title.en: Three Historical Facts about Transcendental Numbers

body.zh: 讲义给出三个历史事实：$\pi$ 是超越数，由 Ferdinand von Lindemann 在 1882 年证明；Joseph Liouville 在 1844 年首次证明了超越数的存在；Georg Cantor 在 1874 年证明超越数远多于代数数。这些事实说明代数数虽然无处不在，但它们在实数中只占很小的一部分。
body.en: The lecture gives three historical facts: $\pi$ is transcendental, proved by Ferdinand von Lindemann in 1882; Joseph Liouville first proved the existence of transcendental numbers in 1844; and in 1874 Georg Cantor proved that there are far more transcendental numbers than algebraic ones. Together they show that although algebraic numbers appear everywhere, they occupy only a tiny part of the reals.

title.zh: 误以为减法也满足交换律与结合律
title.en: Assuming subtraction is commutative and associative

body.zh: 容易错：把加法的运算律照搬到减法上，写成 $a-b=b-a$ 或 $(a-b)-c=a-(b-c)$。正确做法：讲义明确指出减法不满足交换律与结合律；只有在引入负数、把减法写成 $a-b=a+(-b)$ 之后，才能借用加法的运算律，而且此时要先把式子改写成加法形式再使用交换律、结合律。
body.en: The error is carrying the laws of addition over to subtraction, writing $a-b=b-a$ or $(a-b)-c=a-(b-c)$. The correct way: the lecture states explicitly that subtraction satisfies neither commutativity nor associativity; only after negative numbers are introduced and subtraction is rewritten as $a-b=a+(-b)$ may one use the laws of addition, and then the expression must first be rearranged into additive form.

title.zh: 带余除法的余数范围写成 $0\le r\le b$
title.en: Writing the remainder range as $0\le r\le b$

body.zh: 容易错：把带余除法写成 $a=bq+r$，$0\le r\le b$，或忘记 $q,r$ 的唯一性。正确做法：讲义给出的结论是 $a=bq+r$，$0\le r\le b-1$（$b\ge2$），且 $q,r$ 唯一；上限是 $b-1$ 而不是 $b$，因为 $b$ 本身可以写进商里。进制转换题中反复除以 $b$ 取余，得到的余数序列正是这里 $r$ 的取值范围。
body.en: The error is stating $a=bq+r$ with $0\le r\le b$, or forgetting that $q,r$ are unique. The correct way: the lecture gives $a=bq+r$ with $0\le r\le b-1$ for $b\ge2$, and $q,r$ unique; the upper bound is $b-1$, not $b$, because $b$ itself can be absorbed into the quotient. The remainders obtained by repeated division by $b$ in base conversion are exactly the $r$ of this statement.

title.zh: 进制转换时分组位数与读数方向出错
title.en: Wrong group size or reading direction in base conversion

body.zh: 容易错：十进制转二进制时把余数从上往下读；八进制转二进制时按 4 位一组；二进制转四进制时按 3 位一组。正确做法：$2^k$ 进制之间互转按 $k$ 位一组——八进制转二进制按 3 位一组（$0=000,\dots,7=111$），二进制转八进制按 3 位一组、二进制转四进制按 2 位一组（$4=2^2$）；十进制转进制用反复除法且余数从下往上读。写完最好用幂展开验算一次。
body.en: The error is reading the remainders from the top when converting decimal to binary, or grouping in 4 bits when going from octal to binary. The correct way: between bases $2^k$ group in $k$ bits — octal to binary uses groups of 3 ($0=000,\dots,7=111$), binary to octal uses groups of 3, binary to base 4 uses groups of 2 since $4=2^2$; decimal to base $b$ uses repeated division with the remainders read from the bottom up. Always verify once with a power expansion.

title.zh: 证明有理数封闭时忘记 $qs\neq0$ 与互素条件
title.en: Forgetting $qs\neq0$ and coprimality when proving closure of $\mathbb{Q}$

body.zh:
容易错：写 $a+b=\dfrac{ps+rq}{qs}$ 就直接断言是有理数。正确做法：必须补上两句——$ps+rq$ 与 $qs$ 都是整数，且 $qs
eq0$（因为 $q
eq0$ 且 $s
eq0$），这样它才确实是形如 $\dfrac{	ext{整数}}{	ext{非零整数}}$ 的分数。反过来，若要说明两个有理数之差不是有理数，则要用反证法：假设 $a+b$ 有理，推出 $b$ 有理，与已知 $b$ 无理矛盾。
body.en:
The error is writing $a+b=\dfrac{ps+rq}{qs}$ and immediately calling it rational. The correct way: add the two missing checks — $ps+rq$ and $qs$ are integers, and $qs
eq0$ since $q
eq0$ and $s
eq0$ — so the expression really is a fraction of integers over a nonzero integer. In the other direction, to show a sum is not rational you argue by contradiction: assuming $a+b$ rational forces $b$ rational, contradicting the hypothesis.

title.zh: 循环小数的循环节位置与 $\dfrac{1}{1-r}$ 用错
title.en: Misplacing the repetend and misusing $\dfrac{1}{1-r}$

body.zh: 容易错：把 $0.0\overline{14}$ 当成 $0.\overline{014}$，或者套用 $1+r+r^2+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$ 时把公比取成 $10$。正确做法：先确认循环节从哪一位开始——$0.0\overline{14}$ 循环节是 $14$，首项是 $\dfrac{14}{10^3}$、公比是 $\dfrac{1}{10^2}$，故 $\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}=\dfrac{7}{495}$；而 $0.\overline{014}$ 才是 $\dfrac{14}{999}$。首项与公比必须同时对上循环节的位置。
body.en: The error is reading $0.0\overline{14}$ as $0.\overline{014}$, or taking the ratio to be $10$ when using $1+r+r^2+\dots=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$. The correct way: first locate where the repetend starts — for $0.0\overline{14}$ the repetend is $14$, the first term is $\dfrac{14}{10^3}$ and the ratio is $\dfrac{1}{10^2}$, giving $\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}=\dfrac{7}{495}$; whereas $0.\overline{014}=\dfrac{14}{999}$. The first term and the ratio must both match the position of the repetend.

title.zh: 把"有理数"与"实数"、"无理数"混为一谈
title.en: Confusing rational, real and irrational numbers

body.zh: 容易错：认为无理数不属于实数，或认为有理数之外没有数。正确做法：讲义指出所有小数的全体构成实数集 $\mathbb{R}$，无理数当然也属于 $\mathbb{R}$；$\mathbb{Q}\subset\mathbb{R}$ 是真包含。定理 1.1 与 1.2 说的是有理数 $\iff$ 有限小数或循环小数，不是 $\iff$ 有限小数——循环小数同样对应有理数。
body.en: The error is believing irrational numbers lie outside the reals, or that nothing exists beyond the rationals. The correct way: the lecture states that the set of all decimals forms the real numbers $\mathbb{R}$, and irrational numbers belong to $\mathbb{R}$ too; the inclusion $\mathbb{Q}\subset\mathbb{R}$ is proper. Theorems 1.1 and 1.2 say rational $\iff$ finite or repeating decimal, not rational $\iff$ finite decimal — repeating decimals are rational as well.

title.zh: 判定代数数时漏掉 $a_n\neq0$ 或系数必须为整数
title.en: Dropping $a_n\neq0$ or the integrality of the coefficients

body.zh: 容易错：写 $a_nx^n+\dots+a_0=0$ 时不注明 $a_n\neq0$，或系数用了分数、无理数。正确做法：定义 1.1 要求最高次项系数非零且所有系数 $a_0,\dots,a_n$ 都是整数；所以 $x^2-2=0$ 可以说明 $\sqrt{2}$ 是代数数，但 $\sqrt{2}x^2-2x+1=0$ 不能。此外 $0=0$ 这种恒等式不能用来判定任何数。
body.en: The error is omitting $a_n\neq0$, or using fractional or irrational coefficients. The correct way: Definition 1.1 requires a nonzero leading coefficient and all coefficients $a_0,\dots,a_n$ to be integers, so $x^2-2=0$ certifies that $\sqrt{2}$ is algebraic while $\sqrt{2}x^2-2x+1=0$ certifies nothing. The identity $0=0$ is useless for deciding anything.

q.zh: 把十进制数 $134$ 转换为二进制数。
q.en: Convert the number $134$ in base 10 to base 2.

steps.en: Divide repeatedly by $2$ and keep the remainders: $134=67\times2+0$, $67=2\times33+1$, $33=2\times16+1$, $16=2\times8+0$, $8=2\times4+0$, $4=2\times2+0$, $2=2\times1+0$, $1=2\times0+1$.

steps.zh: 把余数自下而上读出，得到二进制数 $10000110$。
steps.en: Read the remainders from the bottom up to obtain $10000110$.

official.en: Official solutions p.1 list the repeated-division-by-$2$ remainder chain ($134=67\times2+0$, $67=2\times33+1$, $33=2\times16+1$, $16=2\times8+0$, $8=2\times4+0$, $4=2\times2+0$, $2=2\times1+0$, $1=2\times0+1$), read from the bottom up as $10000110_2$; it also verifies with $134=2^7+2^2+2^1$ and notes $4=2^2$.

q.zh: 把十进制数 $134$ 转换为四进制数。
q.en: Convert the number $134$ in base 10 to base 4.

steps.en: Divide repeatedly by $4$ and keep the remainders: $134=4\times33+2$, $33=4\times8+1$, $8=4\times2+0$, $2=4\times0+2$.
Reading the remainders from the bottom up gives $2012_4$.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.1 用除法草稿 $4\overline{)33}$ 分解 $134$（$134=4\times33+2$，$33=4\times8+1$，$8=4\times2$），并把二进制结果 $10000110$ 按 2 位一组写成 $2012_4$，另直接展开 $134=2\times4^3+1\times4+2$。
official.en: Official solutions p.1 decomposes $134$ by long division ($134=4\times33+2$, $33=4\times8+1$, $8=4\times2$), then regroups the binary result $10000110$ in pairs to get $2012_4$, and also expands $134=2\times4^3+1\times4+2$ directly.

q.zh: 把十进制数 $134$ 转换为八进制数。
q.en: Convert the number $134$ in base 10 to base 8.

steps.en: Divide repeatedly by $8$ and keep the remainders: $134=8\times16+6$, $16=8\times2+0$, $2=8\times0+2$.
Reading the remainders from the bottom up gives $206_8$.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.1 把二进制结果按 3 位一组写成 $\underline{\underline{1}}\mid\underline{\underline{000}}\mid\underline{110}$ 得 $206_8$，并用 $134=2\times2^6+\dfrac{2^2+2}{6}=2\times8^2+6=206_8$ 核对。
official.en: Official solutions p.1 groups the binary result in threes as $\underline{\underline{1}}\mid\underline{\underline{000}}\mid\underline{110}$ to get $206_8$, and checks with $134=2\times2^6+\dfrac{2^2+2}{6}=2\times8^2+6=206_8$.

q.zh: 把二进制数 $11011100101_2$ 转换为四进制数和八进制数。
q.en: Convert the base 2 number $11011100101_2$ to base 4 and base 8.

steps.en: To base 4: since $4=2^2$ group the bits in pairs, giving $1\mid10\mid11\mid10\mid01\mid01$, i.e. $123211_4$.
To base 8: since $8=2^3$ group the bits in threes, padding on the left to get $011\mid011\mid100\mid101$, i.e. $3345_8$.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.2 先把二进制数按幂展开 $1\times2^{10}+1\times2^9+(1\times2^7+1\times2^6)+1\times2^5+1\times2^2+1$，再按 2 位一组写出四进制 $1\mid\underline{1\quad0}\mid\underline{1\quad1}\mid1\;00\mid1\;\underline{0\quad1}$ 得 $123211_4$，按 3 位一组写出八进制 $\underline{1}\mid\underline{1}\;0\quad\underline{1}\;\underline{1}\mid1\;0\;0\mid\underline{1}\;\underline{0}\;\underline{1}$ 得 $3345_8$，并提示 $4=2^2$。
official.en: Official solutions p.2 first expands the binary numeral as $1\times2^{10}+1\times2^9+(1\times2^7+1\times2^6)+1\times2^5+1\times2^2+1$, then groups in pairs for base 4, $1\mid\underline{1\quad0}\mid\underline{1\quad1}\mid1\;00\mid1\;\underline{0\quad1}$, giving $123211_4$, and in threes for base 8, $\underline{1}\mid\underline{1}\;0\quad\underline{1}\;\underline{1}\mid1\;0\;0\mid\underline{1}\;\underline{0}\;\underline{1}$, giving $3345_8$, with the reminder $4=2^2$.

q.zh: 把四进制数 $123223_4$ 转换为二进制数。
q.en: Convert the base 4 number $123223_4$ to base 2.

steps.en: Since $4=2^2$, expand each base-4 digit into two binary digits: $1\to01$, $2\to10$, $3\to11$, $2\to10$, $2\to10$, $3\to11$.
Writing these in a row gives $01\,10\,11\,10\,10\,11$; dropping the leading $0$ gives $11011101011_2$.

official.en: Official solutions p.3 gives the binary result directly as $1\,10\,11\,10\,10\,11_2$, i.e. $11011101011_2$ (each base-4 digit split into two binary digits).

q.zh: 把八进制数 $123607_8$ 转换为二进制数和四进制数。
q.en: Convert the base 8 number $123607_8$ to base 2 and base 4.

steps.en: Expand $123607_8$ digit by digit: $001\mid010\mid011\mid110\mid000\mid111$, which concatenates to $1010011110000111_2$.

steps.zh: 再把二进制每 2 位一组：$10\mid10\mid01\mid11\mid10\mid00\mid01\mid11$，得 $22132013_4$。
steps.en: Group the binary digits in pairs: $10\mid10\mid01\mid11\mid10\mid00\mid01\mid11$, giving $22132013_4$.

official.en: Official solutions p.4 lists the table $0=000_2$ through $7=111_2$, writes $123607_8$ as $1010011110000111_2$, and then groups in pairs, $10\mid10\mid01\mid11\mid10\mid00\mid01\mid11$, i.e. $22132013_4$.

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 是有理数且 $b\neq0$。证明 $a+b$ 是有理数。
q.en: If $a$ and $b$ are rational numbers and $b\neq0$, show that $a+b$ is a rational number.

steps.zh: 写 $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$（$p,q$ 为整数，$q\neq0$），写 $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$（$r,s$ 为整数，$s\neq0$）。
steps.en: Write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ with integers $p,q$, $q\neq0$, and $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ with integers $r,s$, $s\neq0$.
Over a common denominator, $a+b=\dfrac{p}{q}+\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps+rq}{qs}$.

steps.zh: $ps+rq$ 与 $qs$ 都是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $a+b$ 是有理数。
steps.en: Both $ps+rq$ and $qs$ are integers and $qs\neq0$, so $a+b$ is rational.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.5 设 $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$、$b=\dfrac{r}{s}$，得 $a+b=\dfrac{ps+rq}{qs}$，指出 $ps+rq$ 与 $qs$ 是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $a+b$ 是有理数。
official.en: Official solutions p.5 sets $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ and $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$, obtains $a+b=\dfrac{ps+rq}{qs}$, and notes that $ps+rq$ and $qs$ are integers with $qs\neq0$, so $a+b$ is rational.

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 是有理数且 $b\neq0$。证明 $a-b$ 是有理数。
q.en: If $a$ and $b$ are rational numbers and $b\neq0$, show that $a-b$ is a rational number.

steps.en: Again write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ and $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ with $q\neq0$ and $s\neq0$.
Over a common denominator, $a-b=\dfrac{p}{q}-\dfrac{r}{s}=\dfrac{ps-rq}{qs}$.

steps.zh: $ps-rq$ 与 $qs$ 都是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $a-b$ 是有理数。
steps.en: Both $ps-rq$ and $qs$ are integers and $qs\neq0$, so $a-b$ is rational.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.5 得 $a-b=\dfrac{ps-rq}{qs}$，指出 $ps-rq$ 与 $qs$ 是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $a-b$ 是有理数。
official.en: Official solutions p.5 obtains $a-b=\dfrac{ps-rq}{qs}$, notes that $ps-rq$ and $qs$ are integers with $qs\neq0$, and concludes that $a-b$ is rational.

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 是有理数且 $b\neq0$。证明 $ab$ 是有理数。
q.en: If $a$ and $b$ are rational numbers and $b\neq0$, show that $ab$ is a rational number.

steps.en: Write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ and $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ with $q\neq0$ and $s\neq0$.
Multiplying gives $ab=\dfrac{pr}{qs}$.

steps.zh: $pr$ 与 $qs$ 都是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $ab$ 是有理数。
steps.en: Both $pr$ and $qs$ are integers and $qs\neq0$, so $ab$ is rational.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.5 得 $ab=\dfrac{pr}{qs}$，指出 $pr$ 与 $qs$ 是整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $ab$ 是有理数。
official.en: Official solutions p.5 obtains $ab=\dfrac{pr}{qs}$, notes that $pr$ and $qs$ are integers with $qs\neq0$, and concludes that $ab$ is rational.

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 是有理数且 $b\neq0$。证明 $\dfrac{a}{b}$ 是有理数。
q.en: If $a$ and $b$ are rational numbers and $b\neq0$, show that $\dfrac{a}{b}$ is a rational number.

steps.en:
Write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ and $b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ with $q
eq0$; since $b
eq0$ we also have $r
eq0$ and $s
eq0$.
Dividing gives $\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{\dfrac{p}{q}}{\dfrac{r}{s}}=\dfrac{ps}{qr}$.

steps.zh: $ps$ 与 $qr$ 都是整数且 $qr\neq0$，故 $\dfrac{a}{b}$ 是有理数。
steps.en: Both $ps$ and $qr$ are integers and $qr\neq0$, so $\dfrac{a}{b}$ is rational.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.5 得 $\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{ps}{qr}$，指出 $ps$ 与 $qr$ 是整数且 $qr\neq0$，故 $\dfrac{a}{b}$ 是有理数。
official.en: Official solutions p.5 obtains $\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{ps}{qr}$, notes that $ps$ and $qr$ are integers with $qr\neq0$, and concludes that $\dfrac{a}{b}$ is rational.

type.zh: 证明：有理数与无理数的和
type.en: Sum of a rational and an irrational number

q.zh: 设 $a$ 是有理数，$b$ 是无理数，$a\neq0$。判断 $a+b$ 是有理数还是无理数，并说明理由。
q.en: If $a$ is a rational number, $b$ is an irrational number and $a\neq0$, determine whether $a+b$ is rational or irrational, and justify your answer.

steps.zh: 反证：假设 $a+b$ 是有理数，设 $a+b=\dfrac{r}{s}$，其中 $r,s$ 为整数且 $s\neq0$。
steps.en: By contradiction: assume $a+b$ is rational, say $a+b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ with integers $r,s$ and $s\neq0$.
Write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ with $q\neq0$; then $b=\dfrac{r}{s}-\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{rq-ps}{qs}$.

steps.zh: $rq-ps$ 与 $qs$ 为整数且 $qs\neq0$，故 $b$ 是有理数，与 $b$ 无理矛盾；所以 $a+b$ 必是无理数。
steps.en: Since $rq-ps$ and $qs$ are integers with $qs\neq0$, $b$ would be rational, contradicting the hypothesis; hence $a+b$ must be irrational.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.6 用反证法：设 $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$（$p\neq0$），若 $a+b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ 则 $b=\dfrac{rq-ps}{qs}$ 是有理数，矛盾；故 $a+b$ 是无理数。
official.en: Official solutions p.6 argues by contradiction: with $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ ($p\neq0$), if $a+b=\dfrac{r}{s}$ then $b=\dfrac{rq-ps}{qs}$ is rational, a contradiction; therefore $a+b$ is irrational.

type.zh: 证明：有理数与无理数的积
type.en: Product of a rational and an irrational number

q.zh: 设 $a$ 是有理数，$b$ 是无理数，$a\neq0$。判断 $ab$ 是有理数还是无理数，并说明理由。
q.en: If $a$ is a rational number, $b$ is an irrational number and $a\neq0$, determine whether $ab$ is rational or irrational, and justify your answer.

steps.zh: 反证：假设 $ab$ 是有理数，设 $ab=\dfrac{m}{n}$，其中 $m,n$ 为整数且 $n\neq0$。
steps.en: By contradiction: assume $ab$ is rational, say $ab=\dfrac{m}{n}$ with integers $m,n$ and $n\neq0$.

Write $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ with $q
eq0$; since $a
eq0$ we have $p
eq0$, and $b=\dfrac{ab}{a}=\dfrac{\dfrac{m}{n}}{\dfrac{p}{q}}=\dfrac{mq}{np}$.

steps.zh: $mq$ 与 $np$ 为整数且 $np\neq0$，故 $b$ 是有理数，矛盾；所以 $ab$ 是无理数。
steps.en: Since $mq$ and $np$ are integers with $np\neq0$, $b$ would be rational, a contradiction; hence $ab$ is irrational.

official.zh:
官方详解 p.6 用反证法：设 $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$（$p
eq0$），若 $ab=\dfrac{m}{n}$ 则 $b=\dfrac{mq}{np}$ 是有理数，矛盾；故 $ab$ 是无理数，并指出条件 $a
eq0$（即 $p
eq0$）是关键。

Official solutions p.6 argues by contradiction: with $a=\dfrac{p}{q}$ ($p

q.zh: 把分数 $\dfrac{777}{20}$ 写成小数展开。
q.en: Write the fraction $\dfrac{777}{20}$ in decimal expansion.

steps.en: Then divide by $10$: $\dfrac{777}{20}=38.85$, a finite decimal.

official.en: Official solutions p.7 writes $\dfrac{777}{2}=388.5$ and then uses long division $2\overline{)777}$ ($777-600=177$, $177-160=17$, $17-16=1$, append a zero to get $10$, $10-8=2$) to obtain $\dfrac{777}{20}=38.85$.

q.zh: 把分数 $\dfrac{12}{101}$ 写成小数展开。
q.en: Write the fraction $\dfrac{12}{101}$ in decimal expansion.

steps.en: Long division: $120\div101$ gives quotient $1$ remainder $19$; $190\div101$ gives $1$ remainder $89$; $890\div101$ gives $8$ remainder $82$; $820\div101$ gives $8$ remainder $12$.

steps.zh: 余数 $12$ 回到初始状态，故循环节为 $1188$。
steps.en: The remainder $12$ returns to the starting value, so the repetend is $1188$.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.7 用长除法 $101\overline{)120}$ 写出 $120\to190\to890\to820\to120$ 的循环，得 $0.118811881188\ldots$，并写成 $0.\dot{1}18\dot{8}$（点在循环节首尾）。
official.en: Official solutions p.7 uses long division $101\overline{)120}$ showing the cycle $120\to190\to890\to820\to120$, giving $0.118811881188\ldots$, written as $0.\dot{1}18\dot{8}$ with dots over the ends of the repetend.

note.en: Checking note: the repetend is $1188$ (four digits); you may also verify with $\dfrac{12}{101}=\dfrac{1188}{9999}$.

type.zh: 证明：有限小数的充要条件

q.zh: 设 $p$ 是正整数，$q$ 是大于等于 $2$ 且与 $p$ 互素的正整数。证明分数 $\dfrac{p}{q}$ 有有限小数展开，当且仅当 $q$ 没有除 $2$ 或 $5$ 以外的素因子。
q.en: Let $p$ be a positive integer and let $q$ be a positive integer greater than or equal to $2$ that is relatively prime to $p$. Show that the fraction $\dfrac{p}{q}$ has a finite decimal expansion if and only if $q$ does not have prime factors other than $2$ or $5$.

ans.zh: $\dfrac{p}{q}$ 有有限小数展开 $\iff q$ 的素因子只有 $2$ 和 $5$。
ans.en: $\dfrac{p}{q}$ has a finite decimal expansion if and only if the only prime factors of $q$ are $2$ and $5$.

steps.zh: （必要性）设 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\overline{a_n\dots a_0.a_{-1}\dots a_{-m}}=\dfrac{k}{10^m}$，$k$ 为整数，于是 $10^mp=kq$，即 $q\mid10^mp$。
steps.en: (Necessity) Suppose $\dfrac{p}{q}=\overline{a_n\dots a_0.a_{-1}\dots a_{-m}}=\dfrac{k}{10^m}$ with $k$ an integer; then $10^mp=kq$, i.e. $q\mid10^mp$.

steps.zh: 因 $\gcd(p,q)=1$，由欧几里得引理得 $q\mid10^m=2^m\times5^m$，故 $q$ 的素因子只能是 $2$ 或 $5$。
steps.en: Since $\gcd(p,q)=1$, Euclid's lemma gives $q\mid10^m=2^m\times5^m$, so the only prime factors of $q$ are $2$ or $5$.

steps.zh: （充分性）若 $q=2^a\times5^b$，则当 $a\le b$ 时 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times2^{b-a}}{10^b}$，当 $a>b$ 时 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times5^{a-b}}{10^a}$，分子都是整数，故为有限小数。
steps.en: (Sufficiency) If $q=2^a\times5^b$, then for $a\le b$, $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times2^{b-a}}{10^b}$, and for $a>b$, $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times5^{a-b}}{10^a}$; the numerators are integers, so the decimal expansion is finite.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.8 证必要性：设 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}\dots a_{-m}}=\dfrac{k}{10^m}$，则 $10^mp=kq$，故 $q$ 整除 $10^mp$；由 $p,q$ 互素得 $q$ 整除 $10^m=2^m\times5^m$（旁注欧几里得引理：$a\mid bc$、$a\neq0$、$\gcd(a,b)=1$ 则 $a\mid c$），故 $q$ 的素因子只有 $2$ 或 $5$。官方详解 p.9 证充分性：写 $q=2^a\times5^b$（$a,b$ 非负且不同时为 $0$），情形 $a\le b$ 时 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times2^{b-a}}{10^b}$，情形 $a>b$ 时 $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times5^{a-b}}{10^a}$，故有有限小数展开。
official.en: Official solutions p.8 proves necessity: writing $\dfrac{p}{q}=\overline{a_n a_{n-1}\dots a_0.a_{-1}a_{-2}\dots a_{-m}}=\dfrac{k}{10^m}$ gives $10^mp=kq$, so $q$ divides $10^mp$; since $p$ and $q$ are coprime, $q$ divides $10^m=2^m\times5^m$ (a side note states Euclid's lemma: if $a\mid bc$, $a\neq0$ and $\gcd(a,b)=1$ then $a\mid c$), hence the only prime factors of $q$ are $2$ and $5$. Official solutions p.9 proves sufficiency: write $q=2^a\times5^b$ with $a,b$ nonnegative and not both $0$; for $a\le b$, $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times2^{b-a}}{10^b}$, and for $a>b$, $\dfrac{p}{q}=\dfrac{p\times5^{a-b}}{10^a}$, so the decimal expansion is finite.

type.zh: 循环小数化为最简分数
type.en: Repeating decimal to a fraction in lowest terms

q.zh: 把 $0.0\overline{14}$ 化为最简分数。
q.en: Convert the number $0.0\overline{14}$ to a fraction in lowest terms.

steps.en: Write it as a geometric series: $0.0\overline{14}=\dfrac{14}{10^3}+\dfrac{14}{10^5}+\dfrac{14}{10^7}+\dots$.
Using $\sum r^k=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$: $=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\left(1+\dfrac{1}{10^2}+\dfrac{1}{10^4}+\dots\right)=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}$.
Simplifying, $\dfrac{14}{10(10^2-1)}=\dfrac{14}{990}=\dfrac{7}{495}$, which is in lowest terms.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.10 给出两种做法。其一（蓝笔）：$0.0\overline{14}=\dfrac{14}{10^3}+\dfrac{14}{10^5}+\dfrac{14}{10^7}+\dots=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}=\dfrac{14}{990}=\dfrac{7}{495}$。其二（绿笔）用移位法：$S=0.0\overline{14}$，则 $10^2S=1.4\overline{14}$，$(10^2-1)S=1.4$，$S=\dfrac{1.4}{99}=\dfrac{14}{990}$。同一页上方还用 $S=1+r+r^2+\dots$ 与 $rS=S-1$ 推出 $S=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$。
official.en: Official solutions p.10 gives two methods. First (in blue): $0.0\overline{14}=\dfrac{14}{10^3}+\dfrac{14}{10^5}+\dfrac{14}{10^7}+\dots=\dfrac{14}{10^3}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^2}}=\dfrac{14}{990}=\dfrac{7}{495}$. Second (in green) by shifting: with $S=0.0\overline{14}$ we get $10^2S=1.4\overline{14}$, hence $(10^2-1)S=1.4$ and $S=\dfrac{1.4}{99}=\dfrac{14}{990}$. The top of the same page also derives $S=\dfrac{1}{1-r}$ from $S=1+r+r^2+\dots$ and $rS=S-1$.

type.zh: 循环小数化为最简分数
type.en: Repeating decimal to a fraction in lowest terms

q.zh: 把 $3.14\overline{207}$ 化为最简分数。
q.en: Convert the number $3.14\overline{207}$ to a fraction in lowest terms.

steps.en: Write it as a series: $3.14\overline{207}=\dfrac{314}{10^2}+\dfrac{207}{10^5}+\dfrac{207}{10^8}+\dfrac{207}{10^{11}}+\dots$.
Apply the geometric series to the repeating part: $=\dfrac{314}{10^2}+\dfrac{207}{10^5}\times\dfrac{1}{1-\dfrac{1}{10^3}}=\dfrac{314}{10^2}+\dfrac{207}{10^2(10^3-1)}$.

q.zh: 证明 $\sqrt[5]{2}$ 是代数数。
q.en: Show that $\sqrt[5]{2}$ is an algebraic number.

ans.zh: $\sqrt[5]{2}$ 满足整系数方程 $x^5-2=0$，故为代数数。
ans.en: $\sqrt[5]{2}$ satisfies the integer-coefficient equation $x^5-2=0$, so it is algebraic.

steps.zh: 回顾定义：数 $x$ 若满足整系数多项式方程 $C_nx^n+C_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+C_1x+C_0=0$，则为代数数。
steps.en: Recall the definition: a number $x$ satisfying the integer-coefficient polynomial equation $C_nx^n+C_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+C_1x+C_0=0$ is algebraic.

steps.zh: 该方程系数 $1$ 与 $-2$ 都是整数，故 $x$ 是代数数。
steps.en: Since the coefficients $1$ and $-2$ are integers, $x$ is an algebraic number.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.12 先复述代数数定义（$C_nx^n+C_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+C_1x+C_0=0$，系数为整数），再令 $x=\sqrt[5]{2}$，得 $x^5=2$，故 $x$ 满足多项式方程 $x^5-2=0$，系数为整数，因此 $x$ 是代数数。
official.en: Official solutions p.12 restates the definition of an algebraic number ($C_nx^n+C_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+C_1x+C_0=0$ with integer coefficients), then sets $x=\sqrt[5]{2}$, gets $x^5=2$, and concludes that $x$ satisfies the polynomial equation $x^5-2=0$ with integer coefficients, hence is algebraic.

q.zh: 证明 $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt[3]{2}$ 是代数数。
q.en: Show that $\sqrt{3}+\sqrt[3]{2}$ is an algebraic number.

steps.en: Expanding and rearranging: $x^3-3\sqrt{3}x^2+9x-3\sqrt{3}=2$, i.e. $x^3+9x-2=3\sqrt{3}\,(x^2+1)$.
Squaring both sides to remove the radical: $(x^3+9x-2)^2=27(x^2+1)^2$, which expands to $x^6+18x^4-4x^3+81x^2-36x+4=27x^4+54x^2+27$.

steps.zh: 移项整理：$x^6-9x^4-4x^3+27x^2-36x-23=0$，系数全为整数，故 $x$ 是代数数。
steps.en: Collecting terms: $x^6-9x^4-4x^3+27x^2-36x-23=0$; all coefficients are integers, so $x$ is algebraic.

official.en: Official solutions p.13 sets $x=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt[3]{2}$ and, from $(x-\sqrt{3})^3=(\sqrt[3]{2})^3=2$, expands to $x^3-3\sqrt{3}x^2+9x-3\sqrt{3}=2$, i.e. $x^3+9x-2=3\sqrt{3}(x^2+1)$; squaring gives $x^6+81x^2+4+18x^4-4x^3-36x=27(x^4+2x^2+1)$, which is rearranged to $x^6-9x^4-4x^3+27x^2-36x-23=0$, so $x$ is algebraic. Side notes give the expansions of $(x-y)^3$ and $(a+b+c)^2$ for reference.

q.zh: 证明 $\dfrac{2}{3-\sqrt{5}}$ 是代数数。
q.en: Show that $\dfrac{2}{3-\sqrt{5}}$ is an algebraic number.

steps.en: Set $x=\dfrac{2}{3-\sqrt{5}}$; then $3x-\sqrt{5}\,x=2$.
Square both sides to remove the radical: $(3x-2)^2=(\sqrt{5}\,x)^2$, i.e. $9x^2-12x+4=5x^2$.

steps.zh: 整理得 $4x^2-12x+4=0$，再同除以 $4$ 得 $x^2-3x+1=0$，系数为整数，故 $x$ 是代数数。
steps.en: Rearranging, $4x^2-12x+4=0$, and dividing by $4$ gives $x^2-3x+1=0$; the coefficients are integers, so $x$ is algebraic.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.14 令 $x=\dfrac{2}{3-\sqrt{5}}$，则 $3x-\sqrt{5}x=2$；平方得 $(3x-2)^2=(\sqrt{5}x)^2$，即 $9x^2-12x+4=5x^2$，整理为 $4x^2-12x+4=0$，再写成 $x^2-3x+1=0$，指出这是整数系数多项式方程，故 $x$ 是代数数。
official.en: Official solutions p.14 sets $x=\dfrac{2}{3-\sqrt{5}}$, gets $3x-\sqrt{5}x=2$, squares to $(3x-2)^2=(\sqrt{5}x)^2$, i.e. $9x^2-12x+4=5x^2$, rearranges to $4x^2-12x+4=0$ and then $x^2-3x+1=0$, and notes this is a polynomial equation with integer coefficients, so $x$ is algebraic.

q.zh: 若 $a$ 是代数数，$b$ 是有理数，证明 $ab$ 也是代数数。
q.en: If $a$ is an algebraic number and $b$ is a rational number, show that $ab$ is also an algebraic number.

steps.zh: 情形一：若 $b=0$，则 $ab=0$，而 $0$ 满足 $x=0$，是代数数。
steps.en: Case one: if $b=0$ then $ab=0$, and $0$ satisfies $x=0$, so it is algebraic.

steps.zh: 情形二：若 $b\neq0$，则存在非零整数 $p,q$ 使 $b=\dfrac{p}{q}$；设 $x=a$ 满足 $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$。
steps.en: Case two: if $b\neq0$ there are nonzero integers $p,q$ with $b=\dfrac{p}{q}$; let $x=a$ satisfy $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$.

steps.zh: 令 $y=ab=bx=\dfrac{px}{q}$，则 $x=\dfrac{qy}{p}$，代入原方程并同乘 $p^n$ 得 $c_nq^ny^n+c_{n-1}q^{n-1}p\,y^{n-1}+\dots+c_1qp^{n-1}y+c_0p^n=0$。
steps.en: Let $y=ab=bx=\dfrac{px}{q}$, so $x=\dfrac{qy}{p}$; substituting into the original equation and multiplying by $p^n$ gives $c_nq^ny^n+c_{n-1}q^{n-1}p\,y^{n-1}+\dots+c_1qp^{n-1}y+c_0p^n=0$.

steps.zh: 所有系数都是整数，故 $y=ab$ 满足整系数多项式方程，$ab$ 是代数数。
steps.en: All the coefficients are integers, so $y=ab$ satisfies a polynomial equation with integer coefficients and $ab$ is algebraic.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.15 分两种情形：情形一 $b=0$ 时 $ab=0$ 是代数数；情形二 $b\neq0$ 时写 $b=\dfrac{p}{q}$（$p,q$ 为非零整数），设 $x=a$ 满足 $c_nx^n+\dots+c_0=0$，令 $y=ab=bx=\dfrac{px}{q}$，即 $x=\dfrac{qy}{p}$，代入并同乘 $p^n$ 得 $c_nq^ny^n+c_{n-1}q^{n-1}p\,y^{n-1}+\dots+c_1qp^{n-1}y+c_0p^n=0$，系数均为整数，故 $y=ab$ 是代数数。
official.en: Official solutions p.15 splits into two cases: if $b=0$ then $ab=0$, which is algebraic; if $b\neq0$ it writes $b=\dfrac{p}{q}$ with nonzero integers $p,q$, lets $x=a$ satisfy $c_nx^n+\dots+c_0=0$, sets $y=ab=bx=\dfrac{px}{q}$ so that $x=\dfrac{qy}{p}$, substitutes and multiplies by $p^n$ to get $c_nq^ny^n+c_{n-1}q^{n-1}p\,y^{n-1}+\dots+c_1qp^{n-1}y+c_0p^n=0$ with integer coefficients, hence $y=ab$ is algebraic.

q.zh: 若 $a$ 是代数数，$b$ 是一个满足 $b^2=a$ 的数，证明 $b$ 也是代数数。
q.en: If $a$ is an algebraic number and $b$ is a number such that $b^2=a$, show that $b$ is also an algebraic number.

steps.zh: 因 $a$ 是代数数，$x=a$ 是某个整系数多项式方程 $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$ 的解。
steps.en: Since $a$ is algebraic, $x=a$ is a solution of an integer-coefficient polynomial equation $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$.
Set $y=b$; from $b^2=a$ we get $y^2=b^2=a=x$.

steps.zh: 把 $x=y^2$ 代入原方程得 $c_ny^{2n}+c_{n-1}y^{2n-2}+\dots+c_1y^2+c_0=0$，系数为整数，故 $y=b$ 是代数数。
steps.en: Substituting $x=y^2$ into the original equation gives $c_ny^{2n}+c_{n-1}y^{2n-2}+\dots+c_1y^2+c_0=0$ with integer coefficients, so $y=b$ is algebraic.

official.zh: 官方详解 p.16 设 $a$ 为代数数，$x=a$ 是整系数多项式方程 $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$ 的解；令 $y=b$，则 $y^2=b^2=a=x$，于是 $y$ 满足 $c_ny^{2n}+c_{n-1}y^{2n-2}+\dots+c_1y^2+c_0=0$，系数为整数，故 $b$ 是代数数。
official.en: Official solutions p.16 lets $a$ be algebraic with $x=a$ a solution of the integer-coefficient equation $c_nx^n+c_{n-1}x^{n-1}+\dots+c_1x+c_0=0$; setting $y=b$ gives $y^2=b^2=a=x$, so $y$ satisfies $c_ny^{2n}+c_{n-1}y^{2n-2}+\dots+c_1y^2+c_0=0$ with integer coefficients, and therefore $b$ is algebraic.
